title: 第15章 疯子第16章 完美首演
content_zh:
第十五章疯子
谁也没想到迪甘憋了几分钟之后，居然会作出这么一件让人瞠目结舌的事情来，在蓝色意大利球场，挑衅自家球迷，这种事以前在国际足坛发生过吗？
迪甘算是开了一个先河！
当值主裁判也不知道该怎么办才好了，迪甘挑衅辱骂球迷自然是错的，可是之前亚特兰大球迷攻击迪甘呢？
球迷们这会儿也反应了过来，就在他们愣神的功夫，迪甘又是满嘴f，s的大骂了一通，而后心情舒畅的转身就走。
“混蛋小子！你这算是什么意思！？”
“臭小子，别以为进个球就有什么了不起的，你不过是走了狗屎运！”
“混蛋！有本事比赛结束了别走，我要让你长长我的拳头！”
“莱切队的混蛋，你们都是娘娘腔吗？铲断了那个混蛋的狗腿。”
“小子！别让我在贝尔加莫大街上看到你！”
迪甘悠闲的走着，还把两只手放在了耳边，示意那些球迷再大声些，你们不是喜欢骂吗？尽管骂吧！等着老子打你们的脸。
主裁判这会儿也走了过来，最终他还是打算息事宁人：“年轻人，你最好收敛你的脾气，我不想今天的比赛发生不愉快的事情。”
迪甘笑了，笑得像极了一个好孩子，摊开双手，一脸无辜的说道：“裁判先生，今天的比赛您一定会非常愉快的，我保证！”
迪甘说完就走了，主裁判看着迪甘，紧皱着眉头，他感觉到了，这小子绝对不是个省心的货。
比赛重新开始，莱切队也从一开始就落后的打击之中清醒了过来，他们的足球风格就是这样，崇尚进攻，所以每个赛季，他们都能打进很多精彩的进球，但同样的是，他们的失球数也一样多。
莱切的主帅科曼就是个进攻疯子，但凡是他指教的球队，一上来就喜欢摆出一副拼命的架势。
足球很快就通过了半场，亚特兰大中场只有阿尔贝蒂尼一个后腰，还是略显单薄了些，在莱切的攻击群面前，阿尔贝蒂尼纵然是铜墙铁壁，也难有作为，更多的时候，他都是在用自己的经验，指挥身边的队友。
莱切这只小辣椒发威了，场上攻守形式逆转，迪甘也只能不停的在前场游荡，这些就更给了那些亚特兰大球迷攻击他的理由。
“看看吧！我就知道，那小子就是个蠢货，刚才的进球也是他运气好，现在就原形毕露了！”
只可惜这些极端球迷的嘲笑，并没有引起太多的响应。

刚才的进球能算是运气吗？
如果是运气话，那么迪甘一定是上帝的私生子。
上帝老先生是否动了春心，下凡私会人间女子，无需多言，莱切队的进攻已经推进到了亚特兰大的禁区前。
达拉博纳一记直塞球找到了禁区内的科南，惊得站在前场的迪甘都一阵菊紧，好在萨拉反应及时，倒地伸腿将球挡了出来，可是莱切的进攻还没结束，一直等在禁区外的莱德斯马飞奔向前，迎着球一脚远射攻门。
“危险！”现场解说员一声惊呼，球迷们也是到吸凉气。
泰比反应及时，这厮在豪门和草根球队效力的时候，根本就是两个人，一到了豪门，他就时不时的上演几处惊悚剧，但是一到了吊丝球队，立刻就化身超人，多高难度的球他都能挡出去。
现在也是一样。
只见他一个侧扑，单掌封住了莱德斯马的远射，纳塔利的反应也不慢，上去一个大脚将球踢向了中场。
双方在中场又是一阵缠斗，不过这些和迪甘的关系都不是很大，期间他也有过两次射门，只可惜一次正中莱切门将的胸口，把那厮抽得险些呕吐，还有一次直接飞向了看台，把一个骂迪甘骂得正欢的亚特兰大球迷，嘴巴子上的肥肉都抽到了后脑勺上面去。
虽然两次攻门没进，但是迪甘却打得越来越有信心，他觉得前世那种踢球的感觉现在全都找到了，很快他就不甘心只是顶在前面做一个进球机器了，他开始尝试回撤接球，顿时亚特兰大的进攻变得更加丰富起来。
曼多利尼在场下看着，对他的助手蒙多尼科道：“里卡多！我感觉胜利已经在向我们招手了！”
蒙多尼科自然知道是什么，让他的老搭档变得这么有自信，笑道：“当然，我也能感觉到，不单单是胜利，我还看到一个巨星将在蓝色意大利球场正式开始他的征服之旅！”
曼多利尼一笑，他知道自己是不可能一直拥有迪甘的，迪甘也不会甘心一辈子留在亚特兰大这么一支草根球队，总有一天他会走向更大的舞台，但是那些都没关系，只要现在迪甘是属于这座球场的，那就足够了。
“漂亮的甩头攻门，只可惜被莱切队的后卫在球门线上挡了出去！”现场解说员不无可惜的说道。
球场上的迪甘也是用力揉了揉自己的头发，刚才阿尔贝蒂尼的一脚斜长传，正好找到了他，一记头球，门将都已经投降了，结果却被莱切队的后卫在门线上将球勾了回来。
“没关系，罗德！还有的是时间！”帕齐尼笑着安慰道，可是这会儿他的心里也急了，迪甘还有一个进球，他到现在为止，除了两脚软弱无力的射门之外，什么都没做。
迪甘想进球，他太想进球了，只要蓝色意大利球场看台上的骂声，嘘声还在继续，他就要接连不断的进球，去狠狠抽那些狗眼看人低的混蛋的脸。
莱切队的进攻无果，他们也开始有些急了，比赛已经进行了三十多分钟，他们的进攻很猛，只可惜光开花不结果，而且后防线上也是漏洞百出，如果不是运气好的话，现在他们都已经0：3落后了。
科曼站在场边不断的挥手，示意球员们继续向前压，争取在上半场结束之前扳平比分，只可惜科南的一次铲折，也是运气欠佳，集中了门柱。
萨拉大脚开向前场，阿尔贝蒂尼倚住达拉博纳接住球，紧跟着以达拉博纳为轴，右脚拉着足球，身子转了一圈，成功突破，整套.动作一气呵成，显得格外从容。

过掉了达拉博纳之后，阿尔贝蒂尼顺势前冲，之前的比赛他都显得十分低调，似乎是在适应着亚特兰大的战术，此时突然发力，让莱切队一阵紧张，全线回防，如临大敌。
人们都夸赞托蒂的足球风格极具艺术性，但是真要说到足球艺术，整个意大利，在巴乔退役之后，就要数阿尔贝蒂尼了。
他的推进速度不快，但是走位却极具威胁，莱切队的防守球员想要上前拦截，却被他轻巧的跳球突破。
已经到了大禁区前沿了，这里是阿尔贝蒂尼最佳攻击范围，抡开大腿，做出了射门的动作，莱切的后卫上前想要封堵，却见阿尔贝蒂尼虚晃一枪，将球轻轻的一扣，晃开空挡，紧跟着再射。
足球呼啸着飞出，就好像装了精确制导一样，朝着球门的左下角飞了过去。
莱切门将的反应也不满，倒地扑了过去，他的运气不错，指尖捅到了足球，一个变向，撞在了门柱上。
现场解说员正要为这次精彩的远射未果惋惜，可是话刚到了嘴边，却又变成了另外一套词：“还没结束，迪甘！是迪甘！”
没错，就是迪甘，在阿尔贝蒂尼射门的一瞬间，他就做好了补射的准备，眼看着足球击中门柱之后，高高弹起，他双脚一用力，朝着足球弹过来的方向就扔了出去，足球砸中他的脑门之后又飞向了球门，莱切门将伸手想要去挡，只可惜他的胳膊短了点儿，足球就好像一枚炮弹一样，砸进了球门。
“嘭！”
迪甘只觉得肩膀一阵剧痛，方才他只想着进球，却忘记了要自我保护，结果肩膀狠狠的撞在了球门立柱上。
“上帝啊！但愿他没事！”现场解说员都不禁为迪甘担心了起来。
迪甘有事吗？
废话，不信的话，也上去撞一下！
不过他可不想让那些辱骂他的人看见他倒下，挣扎着爬了起来，又是一路狂奔到了南看台前，这一次他没说话，只是叉腰站着，蔑视的目光投向了那些目瞪口呆的球迷。
“球进了！又是迪甘！他第一次为亚特兰大出场，就梅开二度，现在比赛不过进行了三十五分钟的时间，上帝啊！这个大家伙一个人就干掉了莱切！”
现场在安静了一下之后，立刻响起了震天的欢呼声，只有那些南看台的亚特兰大球迷的心情倍感复杂，选择了闭口不言。
迪甘就这么站着，知道泰比担心他又做出什么出格的事，才拉了他一把，没想到却扯到了伤口，让迪甘一阵皱眉，方才那个球是进了，但是迪甘的肩膀也被撞得不轻。
“罗德！没关系吗？”
迪甘咬着牙，道：“放心吧！还没有征服这座球场，我怎么可能会有事！”
看着迪甘离去的北影，泰比也不禁要感叹：“这小子，就是个彻头彻尾的疯子！”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Madman
No one thought that after holding it in for a few minutes, Deegan would actually do such a shocking thing, provoking his own fans at the Azul Italia Stadium. Has this kind of thing ever happened in international football before?
Deegan is setting a precedent!
The referee on duty didn't know what to do. It was naturally wrong for Deegan to provoke and insult the fans, but what about the Atlanta fans attacking Deegan before?
The fans also reacted at this moment. While they were stunned, Deegan cursed again with f and s in his mouth, and then turned around and left in a happy mood.
"Bastard boy! What do you mean!?"
"You brat, don't think that scoring a goal is anything special. You're just lucky!"
"Asshole! If you have the guts, don't leave until the game is over. I'll make you grow my fist!"
"You bastards from the Lecce team, are you all sissies? Cut off that bastard's legs."
"Boy! Don't let me see you on the streets of Bergamo!"
Deegan walked leisurely and put his hands to his ears, signaling the fans to be louder. Don't you like to scold? Feel free to scold me! Waiting for me to slap you in the face.
The referee also came over at this moment. In the end, he decided to calm down the matter: "Young man, you'd better control your temper. I don't want anything unpleasant to happen in today's game."
Deegan smiled like a good boy, spread his hands and said innocently: "Mr. Referee, you will have a great time in today's game, I promise!"
After Deegan finished speaking, he left. The referee looked at Deegan and frowned. He felt that this kid was definitely not a worry-free guy.
The game restarted, and the Lecce team also woke up from the blow of being behind at the beginning. Their football style is like this, advocating offense, so every season, they can score many wonderful goals, but equally, they concede the same number of goals.
Lecce's coach Koeman is an offensive madman, but any team he coaches likes to put on a desperate posture.
The football passed the halftime very quickly. Atalanta's midfield only had Albertini as a defensive midfielder, which was still a little thin. In front of Lecce's attacking group, even though Albertini had an iron wall, it was difficult for him to do anything. More often, he used his own experience to command his teammates around him.
Lecce's little pepper showed its power, the offensive and defensive patterns on the field were reversed, and Deegan could only keep wandering in the frontcourt. These gave the Atlanta fans even more reason to attack him.
"Look! I knew that boy was a fool. He was just lucky to score the goal, and now his true colors are revealed!"
It's a pity that the ridicule of these extreme fans did not arouse much response.
Can the goal just now be considered luck?
If it's luck, then Deegan must be God's illegitimate son.
Whether Mr. God is infatuated and has come down to earth to have a private meeting with a human woman? Needless to say, the Lecce team's offense has advanced to the front of Atlanta's penalty area.
Darabona found Conan in the penalty area with a through ball, which shocked Deegan who was standing in the frontcourt. Fortunately, Sala reacted in time, fell to the ground and stretched his legs to block the ball. However, Lecce's attack was not over yet. Ledesma, who had been waiting outside the penalty area, rushed forward and met the ball with a long shot.
"Danger!" the on-site commentator exclaimed, and the fans also gasped for air.
Taibbi reacted in a timely manner. When he played for a wealthy club or a grassroots team, he was basically two people. Once he arrived at a wealthy club, he would stage a few thrillers from time to time. But once he arrived at the sling-string team, he immediately transformed into a superman, and he could block any difficult ball.
It's the same now.
He pounced sideways and blocked Ledesma's long shot with one palm. Natalie's reaction was not slow either and he stepped up with a big kick.Kicked the ball towards midfield.
There was another struggle in the midfield between the two sides, but it had nothing to do with Deegan. During this period, he also had two shots. Unfortunately, one hit the Lecce goalkeeper in the chest, making the guy almost vomit. Another time, he flew directly into the stands and slapped an Atlanta fan who was scolding Deegan with joy, and the fat on his mouth was slapped to the back of his head.
Although he failed to score twice, Deegan played with more and more confidence. He felt that he had found all the feeling of playing football in his previous life. Soon he was no longer willing to just be a scoring machine in front. He began to try to drop back to catch the ball, and Atlanta's offense suddenly became more abundant.
Mandolini watched from the sidelines and said to his assistant Mondonico: "Ricardo! I feel that victory is already waving to us!"
Mondonico naturally knew what made his old partner so confident, and smiled: "Of course, I can also feel that it is not just victory, I also see that a superstar will officially start his journey of conquest in the blue Italian stadium!"
Mandolini smiled. He knew that he could not always have Deegan, and Deegan would not be willing to stay in a grassroots team like Atlanta for the rest of his life. One day he would move to a bigger stage, but that didn't matter. As long as Deegan belonged to this stadium now, that was enough.
"It was a beautiful header, but it was a pity that it was blocked by the Lecce defender on the goal line!" the on-site commentator said with regret.
Deegan on the court also rubbed his hair vigorously. Albertini's long diagonal pass just found him. With a header, the goalkeeper had already surrendered, but the Lecce defender hooked the ball back on the goal line.
"It's okay, Rod! There's still time!" Pazzini comforted with a smile, but now he was also anxious. Deegan still had another goal. So far, he had done nothing except two weak shots.
Deegan wants to score goals, he wants to score goals so much. As long as the curses and boos in the stands of the Blue Italia Stadium continue, he will score goals one after another and slap the faces of those bastards who look down on others.
The Lecce team's attack was fruitless, and they began to get a little anxious. The game had been going on for more than thirty minutes. Their attack was very fierce, but it was a pity that it was fruitless, and the defense was also full of loopholes. If it hadn't been for luck, they would have fallen behind 0:3 now.
Koeman stood on the sidelines and waved constantly, indicating to the players to continue pressing forward, trying to equalize the score before the end of the first half. Unfortunately, Konan's tackle was also unlucky and concentrated on the goal post.
Sala kicked forward and Albertini leaned on Darabona to catch the ball. Then, with Darabona as the axis, he pulled the football with his right foot, turned his body in a circle, and successfully broke through. The whole set of actions was done in one go, looking extremely calm.
After passing Darabona, Albertini rushed forward. He had been very low-key in the previous games, as if he was adapting to Atlanta's tactics. At this time, he suddenly exerted force, which made the Lecce team nervous and returned to defense across the board, as if they were facing a formidable enemy.
People praise Totti's football style as very artistic, but when it comes to the art of football, the whole of Italy, after Baggio retires, is Albertini.
His advancement speed is not fast, but his movement is very threatening. Lecce's defensive players want to step forward to intercept, but they are broken by his light jump ball.
Already at the edge of the penalty area, Albertini's best attack range was here. He spread his thigh and made a shot. Lecce's defender stepped forward to block it, but saw Albertini feint a shot, dunk the ball lightly, move it out of the way, and then shoot again.
The football flew out with a roar, as if it was equipped with precision guidance, heading towards the lower left side of the goal.The horn flew over.
The Lecce goalkeeper was also dissatisfied with the reaction and fell to the ground. He was lucky. He touched the football with his fingertips, changed direction and hit the goal post.
The on-site commentator was about to regret the failure of this wonderful long-range shot, but as soon as the words came to his lips, they turned into another set of words: "It's not over yet, Deegan! It's Deegan!"
Yes, it was Deegan. The moment Albertini shot, he was ready to make a follow-up shot. Seeing the football hitting the goalpost, it bounced high. With both feet, he threw it in the direction of the football. The football hit his head and then flew towards the goal. The Lecce goalkeeper stretched out his hand to block it, but unfortunately his arm was a little short, and the football hit the goal like a cannonball.
"Bang!"
Deegan only felt a sharp pain in his shoulder. He was only thinking about scoring a goal, but he forgot to protect himself. As a result, his shoulder hit the goal post hard.
"God! I hope he's okay!" The commentators on the scene couldn't help but worry about Deegan.
Is something wrong with Deegan?
Nonsense, if you don’t believe it, go ahead and hit it!
But he didn't want those who insulted him to see him fall, so he struggled to get up and ran all the way to the south stand again. This time he didn't say anything, just stood with his arms crossed, looking at the stunned fans with contempt.
"The goal is in! It's Deegan again! He scored twice in his first appearance for Atalanta. Now the game has only lasted thirty-five minutes. God! This big guy killed Lecce by himself!"
After a moment of silence, the scene immediately erupted into loud cheers. Only the Atlanta fans in the South Stand felt complicated and chose to remain silent.
Deegan just stood like this, knowing that Taibbi was worried that he would do something outrageous again, so he pulled him. Unexpectedly, it pulled the wound, which made Deegan frown for a while. The goal just now was scored, but Deegan's shoulder was also hit hard.
"Rhode! Is it okay?"
Deegan gritted his teeth and said, "Don't worry! I haven't conquered this stadium yet, how could anything happen to me!"
Watching Deegan leave Beiying, Taibi couldn't help but sigh: "This kid is a complete lunatic!"
